key_insight: The study identifies a qubit-efficient mapping for the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) targeting nuclear ground state calculations.
engineering_relevance: This research highlights the potential of optimizing quantum algorithms for more efficient computational modeling in nuclear physics.
method: Comparison of three qubit-mapping strategies: SD, cSD, and pnSD.
Analysis conducted on mid p-shell nuclei $^{10}$B and $^{12}$C using quantum hardware.
Evaluation of resource counts and error percentages for each mapping strategy.
evidence_signal: The best results from hardware showed a percent error of 0.21% for $^{10}$B using SD to qubit mapping.
watch_item: The findings are based on simulations and noisy hardware, which may affect the accuracy of the results.
paper_title: Qubit-efficient variational algorithm for nuclear structure
